metadata.title: How Devin Builds MoneyGraph Integrations Autonomously
metadata.description: Devin, the autonomous AI engineer, can build complete MoneyGraph payment integrations. Learn how our wiki.json teaches Devin to navigate our SDK.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_description: Devin reads our wiki.json to understand MoneyGraph's architecture. It builds complete payment flows without human guidance.

content.intro: Devin is the leading "autonomous AI engineer" — an agent that can build entire features without constant human guidance. With MoneyGraph SDK v2.2, Devin can autonomously build compliant payment integrations.

wiki_structure.heading: How Devin Learns MoneyGraph
wiki_structure.description: Devin uses a .devin/wiki.json file to understand codebases. Our wiki.json teaches Devin:

sections.name: Domain Mapping
sections.description: Where to find code for different concerns
sections.benefit: When Devin needs to implement KYC, it knows to look at src/resources/customers.ts.

sections.name: Patterns
System Notes

capabilities.heading: What Devin Can Build
items: Complete remittance flows — Customer onboarding through payout
Multi-rail payment systems — Local, SWIFT, mobile money, crypto
Card issuance platforms — Virtual and physical cards

example.heading: Example: Autonomous Build
example.task: Build a payroll system that sends salaries to employees in Nigeria, Kenya, and Ghana
devin_steps: Identifies domains → Banking Logic, Entity Verification, Payment Processing
Follows golden_path → Implements Init → Onboard → Quote → Payout
Applies compliance_rules → Adds KYC checks before every payout
Uses correct namespaces → mg.payouts.create for Nigeria, mg.payouts.mobileMoney.create for Kenya
example.result: A complete, compliant payroll system in under an hour.

best_practices.heading: Best Practices for Devin + MoneyGraph
tips: Start with smart_payout — Tell Devin to use executeSmartPayout() for simple integrations
Point to recipes — Mention the recipes/ folder in your task description
Specify compliance — Remind Devin that KYC is required (it should know, but reinforcement helps)

future.heading: The Future of Fintech Development
future.body: Autonomous AI engineers like Devin represent the future of software development. By providing structured knowledge in wiki.json, we enable Devin to build production-grade fintech applications without constant human oversight.
